Name: Openfire Get Off The Spider (Festival Location Bugfix)
Author: hoshikuzunosora
Description:
Basically what it says on the tin! Slightly edits Openfire's locations during the Spirit's Eve and Winter Star festivals so that way he can be interacted with during them.

[b][color=#ff7700][size=4]HOW TO INSTALL?

[/size][/color][/b]Replace the content.json inside the Openfire at festivals folder with the one provided in this mod! That's it!
I HIGHLY recommend keeping a backup of the original file just in case something goes wrong.

NOTE: THIS IS FOR THE SVE OPENFIRE! NOT THE ORIGINAL!

[u]Chinese Translation:

[/u][size=3]请原谅任何错误或不一致，我正在使用在线翻译来帮助我[/size][font=inherit][color=#e8eaed][size=3]。[/size]
[size=3]
[/size][/color][/font][font=Roboto, sans-serif][color=#e8eaed][size=3]本模组稍微调整了Firecherno的Openfire NPC在圣灵之夜和冬星盛宴期间的错误位置，以便玩家可以与他互动和交谈。

[/size][/color][/font][color=#e8eaed]要安装此修复程序，只需将 Openfire at Festivals 文件夹中的 content.json 替换为我为您提供的内容即可。我强烈建议您备份原始 content.json 以防万一您需要。[font=inherit]
[/font][/color]
此外，此修复适用于 Openfire 的 SVE 版本。
